blocks.text: Why illustrator pdf text problems happen

Most illustrator pdf text problems occur because the PDF format is a complex specification. When you export, Illustrator must translate your live vector paths and live text into a static file. If your system has missing fonts, or if the PDF settings do not include the font data, the text will either drop out or replace with a generic font like Courier.
The cost of bad export settings

When your PDF fails, you lose more than just time. You lose money on reprints and client trust. A single incorrect export can force you to redo hours of work. If a print shop rejects your file, you may miss a deadline entirely.
How to fix illustrator pdf text problems

items: Go to File > Save a Copy.
Choose Adobe PDF (Print) as your format.
In the General tab, select the [PDF/X-4:2010] preset.
Ensure Embed All Fonts is checked under the Advanced tab.
If you still see issues, select your text and press ⇧ ⌘ O to create outlines.

blocks.text: Always keep an original copy of your file with live text. Once you convert text to outlines, you cannot edit the spelling or formatting later.
blocks.title: Keep your live text

blocks.text: Exporting many artboards at once can cause Illustrator to hang. If your file contains complex effects like transparency or heavy gradients, the PDF engine may time out. Try exporting artboards in smaller batches if you encounter crashes.

faq.question: Why does my text disappear in a PDF?
faq.answer: This usually happens because the font is not embedded or there is a conflict with transparency flattening. Try outlining the text or using the PDF/X-4 preset.

faq.question: Should I use Export for Screens or Save a Copy?
faq.answer: Use File > Save a Copy for print work. Export for Screens is optimized for web assets and often strips out the print-specific data needed for professional output.

fixes.title: Create outlines
